861:t_060:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then take a break. I'm counting on you next time, too.」

861:t_060:9.en:
$$レイアム$$
「You did very well, Captain.」

861:t_061:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well done, players. Though we are enemies, I salute the effort you put into this battle.」

861:t_061:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Would you rather not hear praise from someone you tried to kill, and who tried to kill you?」

861:t_061:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is a good reaction. But it is also reckless.」

861:t_061:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm sure you will make a worthy opponent for me. I await the day we settle things on the map.」

861:t_061:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「By then, you will also learn my true intentions.」

861:t_062:4.en:
$$ギルボア$$
「Too bad! It's game over.」

861:t_062:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...What's wrong? This isn't like you, $$バナージ$$.」

861:t_062:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I tried... I did try! I gave it everything I had! And this is what I got!」

861:t_062:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I raised my levels, increased my kill count, and earned funds and $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

861:t_062:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What more am I supposed to do!? What am I supposed to fight!?」

861:t_062:9.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Oh, dear... He's really had it.」

861:t_062:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You all should take frequent breaks so you don't end up like this, too.」

861:t_063:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You're quitting...? Even though you haven't beaten the game yet...?」

861:t_063:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Show me your pride as a Super Robot Wars player.」

861:t_063:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「If you have that courage, come back at once and resume the game.」

861:t_063:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$! You can't talk like that! You'll only drive yourself and everyone else into a corner!」

861:t_063:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's rest a little. You're tired, too.」

861:t_063:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Hey, player! That's how it is, so we'll be taking our leave now, too!」

861:t_064:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I managed to clear this map, too...」

861:t_064:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it took us quite a while, didn't it?」

861:t_064:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're slow, $$バナージ$$. At that speed, I may see the end of this story before you do.」

861:t_064:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm getting used to Super Robot Wars, too! I won't let you do that!」

861:t_064:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well. Then from here on, it's a race. Now, I'll take my leave for today.」

861:t_064:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Players, I hope you'll resume as soon as possible so $$フル・フロンタル$$ doesn't beat us to it.」

861:t_064:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm asking you, too! The outcome of this battle depends on you!」

861:t_065:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You got another game over, $$バナージ$$? Haven't you practiced enough?」

861:t_065:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think you're right, but... It's always like this...」

861:t_065:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I tell myself 'But' and 'Even so,' and everything I do backfires. At this rate, someday I'll find a map I can't clear...」

861:t_065:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then retry after a game over. That way, you can carry over your funds and levels.」

861:t_065:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I never knew there was a way like that...」

861:t_065:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You can start over as often as you need... in life and in games...」

861:t_065:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But if you retry after a game over, you lose the chance to earn the SR Point. Keep that in mind.」

861:t_065:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Then I wish you luck, $$バナージ$$... and all you players, too.」

861:t_066:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, I heard you learned what the Box really is. Please tell me its true nature.」

861:t_066:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「There's no way I can tell you that...!」

861:t_066:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why can't you? Surely I have a right to know, too.」

861:t_066:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Take a good look in front of the screen, $$ミネバ$$! The player is watching this conversation!」

861:t_066:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「There must still be players who don't know what the Box is... I can't spoil it for them!」

861:t_066:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then it seems I'll have to see what the Box is for myself, along with all you players.」

861:t_066:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Everyone... Please lend me your strength so I can learn the truth. I'll be waiting for you to resume the game.」

861:t_067:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn it! Why do the enemy's attacks keep hitting me!?」

861:t_067:4.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, have you properly upgraded your unit's Mobility?」

861:t_067:5.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I believe that making thorough preparations to win a battle is also a soldier's duty.」

861:t_067:6.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「You agree, don't you, $$ダリル$$, $$ワッツ$$?」

861:t_067:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「...They both flew off after hearing what you just said, Captain.」

861:t_067:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「Heh... It seems the $$トライスター$$ haven't prepared enough, either.」

861:t_067:10.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Hmm... You players had better make sure this doesn't happen to you.」

861:t_068:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're taking a break...? Hmph... What a carefree fool you are.」

861:t_068:4.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Since you're struggling against highly mobile enemies, I'll tell you something useful.」

861:t_068:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「If you want your attacks to hit, upgrade your unit's Accuracy, though even that probably won't work against the Colonel.」

861:t_068:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's how it is. If the Colonel has deployed, give up on clearing the game and...」

861:t_068:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...If you use Spirit Commands like 'Strike' or 'Intuition,' you can hit even $$フロンタル$$, though...」

861:t_069:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I suppose I'm just worn out... from this endless fighting...」

861:t_069:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...I'll... I'll put an end to this war!」

861:t_069:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「With the power of the beast of possibility, the $$ユニコーン$$...! So...!」

861:t_069:8.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「No... You can't do it.」

861:t_069:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm talking about 'Super Robot Wars.' No matter how hard you try, it's no use unless the player resumes the game.」

861:t_069:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That's how it is, players. Come back soon so $$バナージ$$'s enthusiasm doesn't go to waste.」

861:t_070:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let us stop here for today.」

861:t_070:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Excuse me... Is there some reason? If not, I'd like you to keep playing.」

861:t_070:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You! Are you questioning the Colonel's decision!?」

861:t_070:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's all right, Captain $$アンジェロ$$. $$バナージ$$ is talking about our attitude toward the game.」

861:t_070:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I must admit, this does feel unfinished... Above all, don't you yourself want to know what happens next?」

861:t_070:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Well... Am I obliged to answer that?」

861:t_070:9.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You've been mouthing off this whole time! Don't mock me, brat!」

861:t_070:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Good grief... It seems we do need a little rest.」
